name: Bubblo Blaster
short: Aim and pop colourful bubbles. Rescue fish, smash stones, endless levels.
full:
Bubblo Blaster is a bright, satisfying bubble shooter in the Puzzle Bobble / Bust-a-Move tradition.

Drag to aim, release to shoot, and match 3 or more bubbles of the same colour to pop them. Anything left hanging falls for a bonus. Chain pops to build a combo and earn rainbow bubbles, charge the power ring and tap it to load a bomb.

MODES
- Levels: an endless campaign of fresh layouts across 5 worlds - beach, reef, jungle, volcano and ice. Each level has its own mission (clear everything, rescue the fish, break the stones or hit a score) and a shot or time limit. Earn up to 3 stars.
- Endless: a ticking countdown that every shot adds time to. Survive as long as you can as new colours, stones and fish appear and rows drop faster.

FEATURES
- Easy one-finger controls, made for portrait play
- Stones that take several hits, trapped fish to rescue, rainbow and bomb bubbles
- Watch an optional ad to continue when you run out of time or shots
- Bright cartoon art and cheerful synthesised music
- Works offline

Free to play with ads. Made by Arcadoff.
